upstream.scope: Six text-only recipe cards; no preview media, audio, template, dependency tree, or upstream SKILL is vendored.

style_contract.validation: The current executing assistant reads the current design.md and records the six fields; this selector validates the declared source path and SHA-256 but does not claim to understand arbitrary Markdown. This record does not ask the user to fill JSON or create another approval.
forbid: a library fallback when a project style contract is absent
style_contract.revision_rule: If design_sha256 drifts, affected shots require review. No lock, approval, render, or old project is changed automatically.
style_contract.knowledge_use: New knowledge-explainer plans should actively search cards for comparison, process, causality, evidence, and data beats when they improve understanding; do not force a card into every sentence or shorten reading time.

catalog_is_not: a renderer or locally proven implementation
a provider selector, provider client, or CLI installer
a budget approval or publishing approval

production_routes_remain.wan: existing configured API only after project selection and budget authorization
